name: Barbell Curl
description: A biceps curl with a barbell: holding it with palms up at shoulder width, bend your elbows to lift it toward your shoulders, then lower it slowly.
setup: Stand tall and hold the barbell with palms facing forward, hands shoulder-width apart.
cues: Curl the bar up without swinging.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep without swinging. About 2 seconds up and 2 seconds down.

keyframes.name: Arms down
keyframes.cue: Bar in front of your thighs, palms forward.

keyframes.name: Curl
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows to bring the bar to your shoulders.
